Persist requester authority on temporary access approval

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-4
  description: |-
    Owner approval decisions were writing an Owner-derived authorization snapshot for the grant turn. Continuation planning and lease provisioning re-resolve the requester with the temporary grant, so the Owner digest could never match and approved access was rejected before GitHub MCP use. Persist the snapshot from the approval requester identity plus the exact temporary account/resource/access grant, and cover approval through continuation plan replay and lease provisioning in runtime tests.
